title: UI UX Designer
jobDescription:
The UX designer must think in non-linear terms: capturing interactions, edge-cases, and the various states of these experiences through deliverables such as user flows, product maps, wireframes, storyboards, and prototypes. They should be comfortable with an agile approach to design, with an emphasis on user testing and rapid iteration.
- Cultivates a deep understanding of product UX across platforms and ensure execution with reverence for a cohesive experience.
- Works closely and collaboratively with the visual designer and product manager on the team to fulfill the overall product/feature vision.
- Manages bandwidth and project pipeline to execute UX design in time with team’s software roadmap.
- Coordinates, executes, and documents user research. Runs user interviews, ethnographic studies, and other research methodology to understand personas and user cases around upcoming roadmapped features.
- Collaboratively brainstorms and evolves feature UX with the product manager and wider team.
- Creates extremely detailed user flows, product maps, wireframes, etc. based on requirements from Product Management, and communicate UX clearly to relevant teams.
- Builds out multi-version comps for user testing.
- Prototypes user experiences and coordinate and run tests with end users.
- Quickly iterate and offer versions based on design critique from peers or from learnings found in user testing or feature response. • Capture all states, edge-cases, “unhappy paths” and path logic for visual UI design and engineering teams to build out. • Evaluate, test, and iterate on current core experiences. • Work with Product Management, Engineering, and Visual UI Design to ensure executed work matches UX vision. title: Data Scientist- CSA
jobDescription:
Havas CSA is looking for a Data Scientist to join our analytics team, working on marketing and media analytics problems across FMCG, BFSI, retail, and automotive clients. The role blends hands-on statistical/ML modeling with a strong understanding of media and marketing performance and requires the ability to translate business questions into data solutions that clients can act on. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and maintain lead scoring models to prioritize high-intent customers/prospects for sales and marketing teams Develop churn prediction models to identify at-risk customers and support retention strategies Design and execute Media Mix Modeling (MMM) studies to measure channel-level marketing effectiveness and guide budget allocation Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from large marketing and transactional datasets Build and productionize data pipelines and models in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or equivalent) Work within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — Big Query, Cloud Run/Functions, IAM, and related services — to build scalable data workflows Translate model outputs into clear, business-relevant recommendations for marketing and media teams Collaborate with client servicing, media planning, and analytics teams to embed data science outputs into campaign and business decisions Stay current on marketing measurement approaches (attribution, incrementality, media effectiveness) and apply them to client problems Required Skills & Experience: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and machine learning Solid SQL skills, comfortable working with large, complex datasets Working knowledge of GCP, particularly Big Query; familiarity with cloud-based data pipelines Practical experience building lead scoring and churn prediction models Experience with or strong conceptual understanding of Media Mix Modeling (e.g., adstock, saturation curves, Bayesian approaches such as Meridian, Robyn, or Py MC-Marketing is a plus) Good understanding of media and marketing concepts — campaigns, channels, funnels, attribution, and marketing KPIs Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders, including clients Willingness to build expertise in Google Ads Data Hub (ADH), or prior exposure to ADH study types (Frequency Analysis, Brand Lift, Path to Conversion, etc.) Good to Have: Experience with GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or other marketing platform data Exposure to reverse ETL / audience activation workflows Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar BI tools Prior experience in a media agency, ad-tech, or martech environment

title: Digital Developer
jobDescription: The Digital Developer will be responsible for building, testing, and deploying HTML5 banners, Emailers, Interactive presentations (IVAs), rich media display assets, and responsive email templates for digital marketing campaigns. The role requires hands-on expertise in front-end coding, optimization, QA, and troubleshooting across devices, browsers, email clients, and ad-serving environments. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency or production environment, handling multiple deliverables, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate execution. Banner Development Develop HTML5 banners, i.e. static, animated, expandable, etc. animated display ads, and rich media assets as per campaign requirements. Create banner variations across multiple sizes, for multiple devises and formats while maintaining consistency in design and functionality. Image optimisation for the web hosting of the banners. Ensure banners are optimized for performance, load time, and platform specifications. Implement click tags, tracking pixels, third-party tags, and ad-server requirements. Conduct testing and troubleshooting across browsers, devices, and ad platforms. Email Development Build and code responsive HTML email templates and Veeva CRM/generic email campaign assets. Ensure compatibility across major email clients including Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, and mobile email applications. Follow email best practices for rendering, responsiveness, accessibility, and deliverability. Work with modular email systems and reusable components where applicable. Support dynamic content implementation and personalization logic when required. Interactive Presentation Development Build and code responsive Interactive Presentations, using HTML, CSS, j Query, Java Scripting for Veeva CRM, Mobile Intelligence, CLM tools. Ensure compatibility across major CRM clients including Veeva CRM, Mobile Intelligence, any other CRMs. Follow best practices for rendering, responsiveness, interactivity, accessibility, User friendly and deliverability. Work with modular content systems and reusable components where applicable. Support dynamic content implementation and personalization logic when required. Production & Quality Assurance Perform end-to-end QA for banners and emails before release. Validate assets against creative layouts, briefs, and technical specifications. Troubleshoot coding issues, rendering inconsistencies, and deployment errors. Maintain organized file structures, version control, and documentation for development assets. Work within deadlines while managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Collaboration Partner with designers, copywriters, account teams, project managers, and production stakeholders. Translate creative files into production-ready digital assets with pixel accuracy. Provide technical recommendations during project planning and execution. Support revisions and updates based on stakeholder and campaign feedback. Required Skills & Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in digital production, banner development, and email development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and basic j Query, Java Script. Hands-on experience in developing responsive email templates, HTML Banners, Interactive Presentation for i Pad using safe, best and standard coding practices. Knowledge of Digital banner ad specifications, ad-serving standards, and platform guidelines. Experience with cross-browser and cross-email-client testing. Familiarity with tools/platforms used for Production, QA and deployment in digital production workflows. Understanding of file size optimization, image compression, and performance best practices. Strong attention to detail and quality. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to manage priorities in a deadline-driven environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in an agency, production studio, or marketing services environment. Veeva certified in Email and CRM. Exposure to dynamic creative optimization (DCO) or personalized email development. Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or similar design handoff tools. Working knowledge of AMPscript, Handlebars, or similar templating/personalization technologies is a plus. Understanding of accessibility standards for email and digital advertising assets. Basic knowledge of analytics tags and campaign tracking implementation. title: Senior PPT Designer
jobDescription: We are seeking a highly creative and detail-oriented Senior Presentation Designer to join our Production Design team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Microsoft Power Point, Adobe In Design, and Figma, with a proven ability to transform complex information into visually compelling presentations, pitch decks, proposals, and communication materials. This role requires exceptional design aesthetics, storytelling ability, and a deep understanding of brand consistency across digital and print formats. The Senior Presentation Designer will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, creative teams, business leaders, and clients to develop impactful visual communication assets that support business objectives. Key Responsibilities Design high-quality, visually engaging presentations and pitch decks using Microsoft Power Point. Create and maintain presentation templates, master slides, and brand-compliant design systems. Develop sophisticated layouts, infographics, charts, icons, and visual storytelling elements. Design brochures, reports, publications, and marketing materials using Adobe In Design. Create wireframes, UI mockups, design systems, and interactive assets using Figma. Translate complex concepts, business data, and creative ideas into compelling visual formats. Collaborate with Creative Directors, Producers, Account Managers, and stakeholders to understand project requirements. Ensure consistency in branding, typography, color schemes, and visual language across all deliverables. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines. Review and enhance existing presentations for improved visual impact and audience engagement. Stay updated with industry trends, emerging design technologies, and best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power Point. Strong expertise in Adobe In Design. Proficiency in Figma for layout design and collaboration. Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator will be an added advantage). Expertise in presentation structuring, typography, visual hierarchy, and layout design. Experience creating infographics, data visualization, and executive-level presentations. Understanding of print production and digital design standards. Professional Skills Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Excellent attention to detail and quality control. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Strong time management and project prioritization skills. Creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities. Preferred Experience Experience working in a Production, Media, Advertising, Creative Agency, Event Production, or Corporate Communications environment. Exposure to client-facing presentation design and executive stakeholder communications. title: QA Analyst-1
jobDescription:
Responsible for the quality assurance testing and analysis of digital products. Includes analyzing requirements, testing in multiple environments, documenting and reporting on test results.The Quality Assurance Analyst test types include functional, integration, regression, UAT, and performance/stress. They analyze test results, and document defects/issues in a variety of tracking systems.
- Defines, develops, implements, and executes test plans against requirements.
- Performs QA testing of web and mobile platform, including acceptance, functional, integration, regression, load, performance, and post-implementation testing.
- Interprets and provides feedback on product requirements and associated test/schedule implications.
- Provides feedback to Implementation Managers on product usability, functionality, and quality.
- Testing landing pages, email delivery, on site check in process, post event follow up touchpoints and integration.
- Prepares customer assets for handoff to other team members and document customer specific processes and work instructions.
- Develops robust campaign documentation.
- Monitor, track, and report test and coverage status and statistics.
- Other duties as defined by management. title: Art Director
jobDescription: Creative thinker with an emphasis on visual expression. Superior comping skills. Able to create layouts and compositions based on existing design parameters. Not client facing. Works under limited direction of ACD or higher. Expected to execute over-arching creative campaign ideas, as well as to round out campaigns originated by other teams. The Visualizer & Art Director is responsible for execution of creative concepts and building layouts while working within media production specifications and client brand guidelines in the execution of omni-channel marketing tactics. The Visualizer & Art Director may also be called upon to ideate and execute de novo creations as well. The role is for experienced creative individuals who have exceptional design and production skills, and can implement them across all media channels. The Visualizer & Art Director is able to seamlessly switch gears between design and production in channels such as print, digital, presentation, branding, and motion disciplines. Creativity: Executes layouts based on creative briefing, brand guidelines and or art direction. Ability to translate layout and design across media and can bring ideas to life. Art and design centric thinking with a passion for health and wellness and the science behind it. Design skills: Excellent design and creative skills, including an overall aptitude for visual communications through typography, color, photography, graphic and art elements. Commanding knowledge of print, digital/interactive design, retouching, and motion design. Basic understanding of UUX/UI design concepts. Branding knowledge: Ability to design materials true to the brand identity of product and style guidelines set. Follows branding guidelines to deliver ancillary pieces based on creative instruction and marketing need. Project and Agency Goals: Ensure work is in line with the goals of the project, and that client needs are met. Adheres to and monitors agency guidelines related to file naming, file and folder management, file preparation and builds, and back-up/archiving. Production Skills: Able to seamlessly switch gears between design and production. Familiar with production concepts such as layer comps, i OS platform, desktop applications, mobile and emails and has knowledge of production requirements for all medium (print design, web design, and motion design). Makes corrections to layouts (art and copy) as indicated by brand team or client. Reviews corrected pages for accuracy and completeness of corrections. Collaborates with Art Directors during preliminary/concepting stages of work to provide composite artwork utilizing Photoshop and/or Illustrator or other current software. May also assist in creating or editing charts, graphs, logos, etc. Leadership and Experience: Is a proponent for new efficiencies and techniques Assists in training freelancers and new employees. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Open communication with supervisor to share progress of work and design and communicates with art team. Is proactive in finding solutions for the project. Knowledge of agency functions or applicability of experience, previous design experience in digital and print. Excellent time management skills –Manages time wisely across jobs, meets agreed upon deadlines and is accountable and responsible for their work. Required skills: BA of BFA degree in graphic design, interactive design, advertising or other design-related program 5+ years of experience Pharmaceutical advertising agency experience a plus Must be able to work flexible hours when needed Quick and proficient Macintosh skills on digital production software including: Adobe CC (Illustrator, Photoshop, In Design, XD), Adobe Acrobat, Sketch, Figma, Pre-Flight software Knowledge of Macintosh operating system Cross-platform knowledge and working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Power Point, Word, Excel) Ability to conceive 3-dimensionally and ability to illustrate a plus Deadline driven, detail oriented, and organized #LI-PD1 Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants irrespective of age, sex, race, ethnicity, disability and other factors that have no bearing on an individual’s ability to perform their job. title: Artworker
jobDescription:
The Studio Artist is responsible for the preparation and refinement of creative materials including preparing electronic layouts for print, web deliverables, slide presentation media and digital. The Studio Artist is responsible for the preparation and refinement of creative materials including preparing electronic layouts for print, web deliverables, slide presentation media and digital.
- Performs general administrative duties and projects as assigned by the Studio Manager or Director.
- Makes corrections to layouts (art and copy) as indicated by brand team or client.
- Reviews corrected pages for accuracy and completeness of corrections.
- Provides composite artwork utilizing Photoshop and/or Illustrator or other current software.
- Works with Creative and Production to translate specifications into production artwork.
- Adheres to and monitors agency guidelines related to file naming, file and folder management, scanning, mechanical builds, prepressing, disk prep, back-up/archiving, and un-archiving of digital files.
- Keeps Studio Manager informed when said guidelines are not being followed.
- Prepares mechanical and/or prepress files correctly, applying knowledge of commercial printing to the construction of these electronic files, as well as troubleshooting documents as necessary.
- Releases perfect, print-ready files as specified.
- Creates and QAs interactive PDFs including form fields, hyperlinks,media insertion, and buttons.
- Develops and retains brand knowledge (colors, logos,master artwork, style, etc.) of products at the agency and a working knowledge of client process and procedures.
- Demonstrates high level of digital efficiency,is familiar with the equipment owned by the agency, manages time effectively, meets deadlines, and pays close attention to detail.
- Assists in developing brand guidelines with Art Directors (colors, logos, master artwork, style) when called upon to do so.
- Prepares comps, boards, and material for presentations to internal as well as external clients. title: Senior Executive- Earned Media
jobDescription: Pivot Roots, a Havas Company, is looking for a dynamic Senior Executive -Earned Media with 2-4 years of experience. The role involves executing and optimizing SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, enhance search rankings, and drive measurable results for clients. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, hands-on SEO expertise, and the ability to manage projects while collaborating with cross-functional teams Key Responsibilities Responsible for improving and enhancing organic traffic for client websites while ensuring defined SEO goals are achieved. Use SEO tools such as Advanced Web Ranking, SEMrush, Moz, etc. to identify, analyze, and resolve technical SEO issues. Conduct and manage keyword research to optimize existing content and identify new growth opportunities. Support and manage the development and execution of content strategies aligned with SEO goals. Manage the implementation of internal and external link-building strategies to improve domain authority and rankings. Monitor and administer web analytics and performance metrics to track SEO effectiveness. Communicate project progress, timelines, and performance results with internal teams and clients. Experience managing clients from GCC and other international markets will be an added advantage. Must Have 2-4 years of experience in SEO / Earned Media / Organic Marketing. Strong knowledge of SEO tools such as SEMrush, Moz, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. Good understanding of technical SEO, on-page, and off-page optimization. Experience in keyword research, content optimization, and link-building strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Basic understanding of HTML, website structure, and search engine algorithms is preferred. title: Designer
jobDescription:
The Designer will explore and conceptualize design options and solutions in conjunction with Directors, Senior Designers and fellow Designers by evaluating design options, developing and pushing to find 'big ideas' based on design strategy and the creative brief. title: Senior Data Analyst
jobDescription: We are seeking a Senior Data / Systems Analyst to support global operational and finance reporting across multiple business systems. This role will own reporting requirements, data definitions, integrations, and data models that underpin a large and growing portfolio of management and operational reports. The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, source systems, and the Power BI reporting team, ensuring a single source of truth, consistent KPIs, and high quality, reliable data across regions and countries. This is a hands on analytical role, focused on requirements definition, data modelling, integration design, and governance, rather than report development. Own end‑to‑end integration specifications for all global reports Define how data flows between systems and into the reporting layer Validate and reconcile data across source systems and reporting outputs Act as the central point of ownership for reporting logic and assumptions Own assumptions, calculations, and logic behind all reported financial metrics Ensure reports support finance use cases such as: Management reporting Actuals vs budget vs forecast Project and margin reporting Revenue, cost, and profitability analysis Requirements & Stakeholder Management Elicit, document, and manage clear reporting requirements from global and local stakeholders Translate business questions into structured data requirements for the Power BI reporting team Support requirements definition for individual reports and dashboards Challenge local requirements to ensure consistency, scalability, and alignment with global standards Partner with Finance leadership, regional finance teams, FP&A, and Controlling to define clear reporting requirements Translate finance questions into structured data requirements for the Power BI team Data Definitions & Governance Own data definitions, KPI definitions, field mappings, and calculation logic Establish and enforce reporting standards (naming conventions, metrics, dimensions, hierarchies) Ensure consistent KPI definitions across countries, regions, and business units Prevent conflicting numbers and “multiple versions of the truth” Data Modelling & Architecture Design and maintain reporting data models (e.g. star schemas, relationships, measures) Define grain, dimensions, facts, and aggregation logic Partner with Power BI specialists to ensure models support performant and scalable reporting Data Integration & Quality Connect and reconcile data from multiple systems (e.g. ERP, HR, project management tools, finance systems) Work with messy, incomplete, and non‑aligned data sources, identifying gaps and inconsistencies Validate data quality, completeness, and accuracy before and after go‑live Define rules for data transformations and harmonisation Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement Support investigation and resolution of data and reporting issues post go‑live Perform root‑cause analysis of discrepancies and work with system owners to resolve issues Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate reporting data flows Documentation Maintain comprehensive documentation including: Data definitions and KPI dictionaries Field mappings and transformations Report logic and assumptions Data lineage and source‑to‑report traceability Required Experience & Skills Significant experience in a Senior Systems Analyst, Integration Analyst, or Reporting Analyst role Strong background in enterprise reporting and analytics in a global environment Proven experience working with multiple source systems (ERP, HR, project systems, financial systems) Strong understanding of data modelling concepts (star schemas, dimensions, facts, measures) Hands‑on experience defining data requirements for BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, similar) Excellent ability to work with complex, messy, and inconsistent data Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills Desirable Experience in finance or operational reporting in a multi‑country organisation Knowledge of data governance and KPI standardisation frameworks Familiarity with Power BI data modelling and DAX concepts (requirements‑level, not development) Experience working with global reporting programmes or transformations Key Competencies Highly structured and detail‑oriented Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Able to challenge assumptions and drive data clarity Comfortable operating as the single point of ownership for definitions and logic Able to balance global standards with local reporting needs Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants irrespective of age, sex, race, ethnicity, disability and other factors that have no bearing on an individual’s ability to perform their job. If you don't find a suitable opening on our Career Site, don't worry! You can still send your resume to us. Please go to Consider me for Future Openings. title: Power BI Specialist
jobDescription: We are seeking an experienced Power BI Specialist to support a global reporting initiative, with a primary focus on utilisation and performance reporting across multiple regions and business units. This role will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining high quality Power BI reports and dashboards that provide reliable, scalable and user friendly insights for Finance, Operations and senior stakeholders globally. The role combines strong technical Power BI expertise with the ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable reporting. The Power BI Specialist works closely with Global Finance and Operations leadership and regional Finance/Ops teams and collaborates with IT and data platform teams on data access, refresh and governance topics. Reporting & Dashboard Development Design, build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards aligned to defined business and reporting requirements Translate business needs into technical specifications, semantic models and effective data visualisations that support decision‑making. Develop reusable report templates, standardised layouts and visual design patterns to ensure consistency across the global reporting suite. Performance & Optimisation Optimise Power BI report performance, including: Query efficiency Data model design Load times and refresh behaviour Overall usability and end‑user experience Apply best practices around DAX, Power Query, and model optimisation. Deployment & Environment Management Manage Power BI deployment pipelines across environments (Dev → Test → Prod). Support controlled releases, versioning and change management for reports and datasets. Support, Enhancements & Troubleshooting Troubleshoot data and report issues, investigate defects and implement fixes in a timely manner. Handle ongoing enhancements and change requests as reporting requirements evolve. Support data validation and consistency checks Stakeholder & User Support Provide user support and training, including explaining metrics, report functionality and self‑service capabilities. Work closely with Finance, Operations, HR and IT stakeholders to ensure reports meet both technical and business expectations. Contribute to documentation covering data definitions, calculations, report logic and usage guidance. Required Experience & Skills Technical Skills Strong hands‑on experience with Microsoft Power BI (Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service). Advanced experience with: DAX Power Query / M Data modelling (star schemas, performance‑optimised models) Experience managing Power BI deployment pipelines and environment separation. Familiarity with data from multiple systems (e.g. timesheets, HR, finance, resource management tools). Reporting & Data Proven experience delivering financial, operational and utilisation reporting at scale. Strong understanding of KPIs, metrics, benchmarks and business logic in a reporting context. High attention to detail around data quality, consistency and accuracy. Stakeholder & Ways of Working Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear technical solutions. Comfortable working with global stakeholders across time zones. Able to balance delivery speed with robustness and maintainability. Desirable (Nice to Have) Experience working in global or multi‑region organisations. Exposure to governance, access control and data privacy considerations (e.g. GDPR). Experience with documentation standards and reporting best practices at enterprise scale. Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants irrespective of age, sex, race, ethnicity, disability and other factors that have no bearing on an individual’s ability to perform their job. title: Submission Specialist
jobDescription: Prose on Pixels is looking for a full-time Submission Specialist to play a key role in supporting the operations team. The candidate will partner with project management, account, editorial, copy to ensure flawless project submissions in client platforms like Veeva, Zinc, MAP. We offer a positive, team-oriented environment and are looking for an experienced candidate that will be trained in our process. The Submission Specialist will be responsible for working with the extended teams on the coordination and preparation of documents for submission to our client’s medical, legal, and regulatory review panels. This role will serve as the go-to expert on the client regulatory submission process and the systems/tools used for the submission. S/he will also be responsible for staying abreast of updates, creating/maintaining the regulatory process binders and working with PMs to communicate updates to project teams. You will work across several clients and brands and be responsible for supporting the project teams on ancillary activities as needed. Works closely with project management, account, editorial, copy and junior submission specialists, to ensure all components of submission meet platform requirements. • Become the expert on system requirements • Be the primary point of contact for all submission needs and guidance • Become the internal gatekeeper/QA for submission packages • Attend initial/ongoing training updates on submission platform requirements • Review job starter form, and project brief for accuracy • Review mandatory items, PI, ISI, to ensure they are represented correctly • Confirm file formats, naming conventions per guidelines • Confirm all support materials are included, i.e., references, layout indicators, functional annotations • Review tagging and linking of references in system to ensure accuracy • Develop knowledge of reference library and expiration dates • Collaborate with team to solve problems and resolve questions regarding submissions • Continuously look to improve the process standards to ensure quality • Partner with account team to compile a list of brand standard/global mandatories • Maintain a submission calendar for brand team • Understand OPDP submission requirements and complete QC checks • Manage multiple submissions and deadlines • Maintain accurate documentation • Provide guidance to junior submission specialist as needed Requirements: 5+- years’ experience in pharma advertising with knowledge of regulatory review process. Strong planning and organization skills with extraordinary attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a basic comprehension of scientific content. Background in account management/project management ideal, but candidates with copy or editorial background could also be trained. Proficient with MLR Submission Platforms, Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat. Efficient, self- starter, quick study, flexible. Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience required. #LI-PD1 Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. title: Copywriter
jobDescription:
The entry level Copywriter is expected to exhibit outstanding writing and work collaboratively with the art direction and design team in achieving the highest possible standards for all materials. The role requires working knowledge of clients business challenges and the ability to lead copy to address specific marketing objectives. The Junior Copywriter must have a basic understanding creative departmental procedures, such as routing, print production protocols, usage rights of stock images for layout, etc. Daily responsibilities include working with a art director to generate and execute creative concepts from ideation through finished product.
- Work must adhere to clients marketing strategies and objectives, meeting deadlines within budget on client projects.
- Helps perform research (general lit searches as well as specific topic research) via internet and other resources.
- Assists art director partner in analyzing and interpreting data.
- Contributes innovative ideas appropriate to the clients marketing strategy
- Develops understanding of audience needs and targets designs and tone styles to appropriately meet them.
- Produce tone and style for copy on the assigned project that is complementary to the layout and art.
- Understands and implements agency/client review and routing systems; makes revisions to agency copies, identifies problems or inconsistencies, solves problems by reviewing with supervisor/account services.
- Participates with creative and brand team to develop multiple concepts/campaigns for assigned products/projects.
- Must be able to develop a range of creative executions for each project and be able to effectively collaborate with art director partner to ensure that words and image work together to support the concept.
- Logically organizes content material from a range of sources to create a compelling narrative/story flow.
- Ability to adapt concept to all mediums.
- Communicates with team members at all times regarding deadlines, revisions, quality control and new work.
- Makes sound, timely decisions regarding need to change work in progress and reports them to supervisor.
- Work with art director to support creative approaches to communicate Brand personality and tone for both the overall campaign and individual materials. title: Artworker
jobDescription:
Prose on Pixels is seeking a talented and meticulous Artworker to prepare and finalize creative assets for various marketing and advertising campaigns across print and digital platforms, ensuring brand consistency and technical accuracy. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Prepare final artwork files for print production (e.g., brochures, posters, packaging, OOH) ensuring correct bleed, trim, and color profiles. * Develop and adapt creative assets for digital platforms (e.g., social media, web banners, email templates) to meet technical specifications and file size requirements. * Ensure all artwork adheres strictly to brand guidelines, maintaining consistency in typography, color palette, imagery, and layout. * Collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and account managers to understand project requirements and implement feedback efficiently. * Conduct thorough quality checks on all artwork before release, identifying and correcting any errors or inconsistencies. * Manage and organize digital asset libraries, ensuring files are correctly named, versioned, and easily accessible. * Stay up-to-date with industry best practices, software updates, and emerging technologies in print and digital production. * Assist with image retouching, color correction, and other graphic manipulation tasks as needed. Job Qualifications * Proven experience as an Artworker or similar role, preferably within an advertising agency or in-house creative team. * Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (In Design, Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat Pro). * Strong understanding of print production processes, including color management (CMYK, Pantone), resolution, bleed, and pre-press requirements. * Solid knowledge of digital asset specifications for various platforms and devices. * Exceptional attention to detail and a keen eye for accuracy. * Ability to work efficiently under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet tight deadlines. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical requirements clearly. * A portfolio demonstrating strong artworking skills and adherence to brand guidelines. * Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field is preferred. #LI-PD1 Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. title: Campaign Quality Assurance Specialist
jobDescription:
The Campaign Quality Assurance Specialist is a critical member of the Client Services team, responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of campaign setup, execution, and documentation across multiple clients. The QAS works closely with Account Coordinators and receives oversight from Account Managers or Supervisors, with direct quality reporting to the ICS Operations Manager. This role ensures that campaign details are thoroughly vetted and compliant with internal standards and client-specific requirements. This is a detail-intensive role designed for someone who thrives on catching the small things before they become big issues, helping safeguard quality in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Participate in onboarding and training on our proprietary media planning and buying platform, Vantage Point, including how to access and interpret critical campaign details, under the guidance of the Quality Control Operations Lead. Conduct daily or rotating audits (depending on team volume) of client materials, reports, and campaign documents across assigned accounts. Reports may be in Vantage Point, Excel, Power Point, and/or Power BI. Review and confirm the accuracy of key campaign elements including: –Creative flighting and allocations –Budget entries and pacing –Traffic instructions and upfront flighting –Holiday/airing restrictions –Buying restrictions and separation requirements –Buy details across media types •Document all audit results clearly, including date/time of check, and escalate any discrepancies to the ICS Operations Manager with AM/AS CC’d •Collaborate with Account Coordinators on campaign QC, while ensuring all reviews are approved by designated AM or AS •Complete formal error documentation reports for any issues that reach market, including timelines, severity assessment, and resolution proposals •Partner with the ICS Operations Manager and New Innovator Operations role to test and implement efficiency solutions, including piloting AI tools and automations within VP •Support process innovation and workflow refinement through collaboration and feedback loops with cross-functional teams •Assist with other projects/account management needs on an ongoing basis including (but not limited to): media schedules, pre-logs, call forecasting, and media performance reports •Participate in training sessions and maintain up-to-date knowledge of internal tools, client requirements, and compliance standards WHO YOU ARE: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: Meticulous attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills Strong sense of accountability and process ownership Ability to identify issues proactively and communicate them clearly Comfortable working independently within a structured framework Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities You are self-motivated; inquisitive, proactive & strong initiative (learns/ask questions, applies, grows) PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS: 1–2 years of experience in a media, operations, traffic, or auditing role preferred Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power Point; familiarity with media or reporting tools a plus Experience reviewing structured documentation (schedules, budgets, reports, etc.) Interest in operational innovation, systems thinking, and QC methodologies Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Advertising, or a related field preferred but not required WHO WE ARE: Build the Business. Build the Brand. At Havas Edge we influence people to act by combining multi-channel marketing and commerce, plus the creative and technology that powers them. Our work results in profitable growth and lasting relationships between customers and our clients’ brands. We are an award-winning, international, performance marketing agency with a proven track record of helping clients succeed. We're an integrated agency that embraces every media channel; a creative powerhouse that loves data and analytics, and a passionate partner committed to giving clients more for less. With expertise across all digital, broadcast, and media domains, we help our clients build their businesses and brands
- in that order. Havas Edge is part of the Edge Performance Network (EPN), a full-service, global performance marketing network. The EPN offers clients expertise in all aspects of performance marketing, from analytics to strategy, creative and production, media planning, and buying across all channels, as well as the industry’s best attribution and modeling capabilities. We are a full-service, direct response agency, headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with offices and affiliated offices in Boston, MA; London, UK; Los Angeles, CA; and Paris, FR. #LI-PD1 Contract Type : Permanent Here at Havas across the group we pride ourselves on being committed to offering equal opportunities to all potential employees and have zero tolerance for discrimination. title: Software Engineer - DevOps
jobDescription: We are looking for a hands-on Dev Ops Engineer with strong experience in cloud platforms (Azure & AWS), CI/CD automation, containerization, and infrastructure as code. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, driving automation-first practices, and leveraging AI/ML-driven monitoring and optimization (AIOps) to improve reliability, security, and scalability. Cloud & Infrastructure • Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure on AWS and Azure • Implement high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies • Manage cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools like Terraform Cloud Formation • Optimize cloud costs using Fin Ops best practices CI/CD & Automation • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as: • Azure Dev Ops • Git Hub Actions • Git Lab CI • Jenkins • Automate build, test, and deployment workflows • Improve deployment frequency and reduce MTTR Containers & Orchestration • Containerize applications using Docker • Deploy and manage workloads on Kubernetes (AKS / EKS) • Configure Helm charts for application deployment • Manage container security and image scanning Monitoring, Logging & AIOps • Set up monitoring and alerting using: • Azure Monitor • Prometheus & Grafana • ELK / EFK Stack • Implement AI-driven monitoring & anomaly detection (AIOps) • Use predictive alerts and automated remediation where possible • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews Security & Compliance (Dev Sec Ops) • Implement Dev Sec Ops practices across CI/CD pipelines • Manage secrets using Azure Key Vault / AWS Secrets Manager • Perform vulnerability scanning and security audits • Ensure compliance with security standards (ISO, SOC2, GDPR – as applicable) Scripting & jobDescription:
The Social Media Strategist will be responsible in the development of strong strategic digital plans, managing the strategy, implmentation and monitoring of approved plans across assigned client(s). The Social Media Strategist has experience in Community Management across multiple social channels, Insights & Analytics/Measurement understanding, and Paid Media experience.The Social Media Strategist will be responsible in the development of strong strategic digital plans, managing the strategy, implmentation and monitoring of approved plans across assigned client(s). - Leads social strategies, campaigns and initiatives—confidently addressing and planning questions ranging from social format to platform functionality.
- Creates content calendars that move beyond channel tactics to support business objectives.
- Works with team to schedule organic posts and the media team on paid campaigns.

- Works across video, branding campaigns, broader marketing initiatives.
- Develops guides for community manager responses to train clients' internal teams.
- Works with project management on timelines and budgets.

- Uses third-party platforms to schedule organic campaigns.
- Be on top of competitive social activities.

title: Associate Director – Strategy & Planning
jobDescription:
As an Associate Planning Director/Associate Strategy Director will be responsible for consulting with our clients on how to increase their brands value through various branding strategies including brand positioning, brand architecture, brand valuation/analytics, internal brand engagement and digital brand strategy. Job Description – Associate Director – Strategy & Planning The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing brand strategies across industries for both enterprise and consumer brands, guiding market research, shaping brand identity, and developing comprehensive marketing and communication strategies. This role will require a strong strategic mindset, creativity, and proven experience in managing large-scale brand initiatives. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead brand positioning studies and conduct primary and secondary research to understand consumer behaviour and define the position Understand and apply frameworks Create guidelines that define the brand voice both online and offline (including terminology and slogans) Conduct in-depth competitive research to identify opportunities, threats, strengths, and weaknesses. Design and oversee promotional campaigns for product launches and new market entry. Develop marketing and communication strategies aligned with business goals. Evaluate the effectiveness of advertising and marketing campaigns, recommending data-driven improvements. Act as a brand custodian while managing strategic accounts and high-impact projects. Requirements: 4-6 years of proven work experience as a Brand Strategist or in a senior marketing/branding role with excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and analytical skills Strong portfolio of brand-building and strategy projects. Deep understanding of the full marketing mix and evolving digital landscape. Expertise in market segmentation, consumer research, and competitive analysis. Strong analytical, data-driven thinking combined with creative problem-solving. Demonstrated experience in leading cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives. title: Lead Solutioning Consultant- CSA
jobDescription:
As the Solutioning Lead at Havas CSA, you will architect integrated marketing and advertising technology solutions across client accounts. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, technology, and client success, you will lead discovery sessions, design solution blueprints, and collaborate with internal teams to translate client challenges into tech-enabled experiences that deliver measurable results.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Client-Facing Solutioning Serve as the primary technology thought partner for strategy, client servicing, and business teams during new pitches and ongoing projects. Lead technical discovery sessions to uncover business needs and align them with relevant Mar Tech and Ad Tech solutions. Design tailored solutions involving CDPs, analytics, personalization, CRM, campaign automation, media platforms, and measurement. Solution Architecture Create scalable architecture diagrams and implementation roadmaps across: Mar Tech: CDPs (Tealium, Segment, Adobe), CRM (Salesforce, Hub Spot), Marketing Automation (Braze, Mo Engage) Ad Tech: DSPs (DV360, TTD), Ad Servers, DMPs, MMPs Analytics & Data: GA4, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, Big Query Balance immediate needs with long-term scalability and privacy requirements. Pitch & Proposal Support Collaborate with business development and strategy teams to craft solution narratives, proposals, and RFP responses. Represent the agency in client meetings, delivering demos and POVs that establish us as a strategic partner. Internal Collaboration Work closely with data, engineering, creative tech, and media teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions. Define use cases and user stories for implementation teams; guide execution as needed. Innovation & Thought Leadership Stay ahead of emerging trends like cookieless advertising, AI/ML in marketing, and identity resolution. Contribute to building reusable solution frameworks, case studies, and capability decks for the agency. What You’ll Bring Experience: 6–10 years in a digital agency, consulting firm, or marketing technology environment. Hands-on experience in marketing technology stack planning, including CDPs, automation tools, tag management systems, and identity frameworks. Strong understanding of media ecosystem, performance measurement, and audience strategy. Skills: Ability to simplify complex technology for non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in creating technical documentation, user flows, and solution blueprints. Bonus: Knowledge of cloud platforms (Google Cloud, AWS), APIs, and Java Script tagging is a plus. Mindset Consultative and client-first. Solution-oriented with a balance of creativity and logic. Proactive collaborator with a strong sense of ownership.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in marketing, Computer Science, Business, or related field. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to work with leading brands while solving complex analytical challenges. Join our team to grow your career while making a significant impact through data-driven decision making. title: Senior Copywriter
jobDescription:
The Senior Copywriter creates copy for print and digital advertising, to video, social media properties or a combination of all three complimenting the art direction. The Senior Copywriter will be an integral part of our creative department, working closely with our creative and strategy teams.This role brings big idea thinking and a highly skilled craft of words with flexibility in writing styles for multiple clients, in varying mediums.
- Presents the desire, passion, and ability to concept and write for banner ads, splash pages, site redesigns and microsites to print ads, brochures, and broadcast scripts.
- Demonstrates creative experience across all channels—expertly and hands-on.
- Has experience in planning and managing photo and video shoots and broadcast production.
- Demonstrates excellent attention to detail.
- Has experience managing and supporting a team. Delegating as well as inspiring, teaching, and wrangling.
- Be self-sufficient and able to work pro-actively and independently if required, with minor support from Creative Directors.
- Partners with strategy, creative teams, UX, technology, and project management to ensure the project meets objectives and deadlines.
- Be able to view account holistically, understanding and assessing the competitive landscape.
- Take an active part in internal and client meetings.
- Be able to explain and articulate design decisions and rationale with confidence.
- Commit to the totality of the account—bring the same level of focus, talent and care to ALL projects, small as well as big. About Havas Creative Network India Havas Creative Network India is the conglomerate of creative agencies and home to some of the most talented people in the disciplines of creativity, strategy, design, experiential, content, PR, CX and UX. Its ethos and philosophy are firmly within the global framework Meaningful Brands through which we make Meaningful Difference to consumers. title: Associate Creative Director-Copy
jobDescription:
ACDs produces and supervises high-level, quality, core concept material and other visuals and designs to achieve creative excellence on behalf of our clients. ACDs are key client facing creative staff, and are both hands-on creators and strategically insightful contributors. The ACD is tactically involved in the concept, design, and execution of integrated, cross-channel initiatives and demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of the client’s brand and overall industry. Supports business growth and pushes the envelope on developing ground-breaking creative content.
- Creates high-quality deliverable and generates new and innovative ideas, alongside partners and under the supervision of Creative Director/ECD
- Create and develop broad range of concepts onl strategy
- Collaborates to refine creative briefs and interacts with project teams to understand business objectives and audience demographics, translating concepts into effective visualizations.
- Review work from junior teams, using judgment to advance the best thinking that is in line with brief and project scope.
- Presents and sells ideas to clients; listens and interprets client feedback.
- Fluency in both digital and traditional channels, including all social media platforms, content creation, video, and understands best production practices.
- Understanding the client’s needs with the ability to develop, present and sell creative concepts to clients.
- Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts to expand current assignments and acquire new projects.
- Uses presentation skills and command of visual ideas to help win pitches.
- Supervise and delegate work successfully within collaborative teams.
- Ability to provide effective creative feedback on work and help make the junior talent produce better work
- Transfer industry best practices and innovative ideas to your team – Foster passion, hunger and curiosity to produce better work in your teams.
- Assist CD’s in hiring and managing group of direct reports. title: Sr Technical Project Manager
jobDescription:
Team Overview The Project Management team offers leadership and follow-up to all digital production activities within our projects, offering our internal clients (agencies) high quality units (emails, banners, interactive panels, interactive presentations, websites, and apps) for most of the top brands in the pharmaceutical industry (often for other industries as well). Introduction: As a Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for executing activities related to end-to end project management that ensure a successful delivery (within time and budget, with the quality expected). Those duties include requirement review, planning, estimating, resource allocation, oversight of development and quality assurance tasks, risk management. You will also help the agencies of our network on projects to come, by validating feasibility and offering guidance. Additionally, you will manage the communications with our counterparts at the agencies and the expectations of the different stakeholders in a way that the scope, cost, time, risks, and changes are well understood and accepted. When required, you will act as the point of contact of a specific agency team to better understand their project pipeline and plan resources accordingly. You will work on process and metrics review or definition, as well as evaluate their impact and suggest improvement/correction actions. In addition, you will act as mentor to other Project Managers in their career path, inspiring them and sharing knowledge with them. Finally, when requested, you can also help on talent acquisition activities by conducting interviews. Job Description Summary : Prose on Pixels is a global content at scale agency built to address the marketing challenges of today and deliver meaningful content into the future. With our unique Audience-First production model, we Create, Scale and Personalize content to captivate audiences and achieve desired brand and business outcomes. Fusing creativity and performance, we create harder working, more sustainable content, reducing waste, and providing stronger ROI. title: Senior Executive - Biddable Media
jobDescription:
Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Keyword Research and Analysis: o Conduct comprehensive keyword research to identify high-performing keywords relevant to the business and industry. o Analyze keyword trends and competition to optimize ad targeting and bidding strategies.
2. Campaign Management: o Develop and execute paid social media advertising campaigns across platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Tik Tok, Snapchat Twitter, Linked In, etc. o Create, manage, and optimize pay-per-click (PPC) advertising campaigns across various platforms (UAC, Shopping Ads, Google Ads, Bing Ads). o Develop and implement ad copy and landing page strategies to improve ad relevance and quality score.
3. Budget Management: o Monitor and control advertising budgets to ensure optimal allocation of resources and ROI. o Track campaign expenses, analyze cost per acquisition (CPA), and adjust bids accordingly.
4. Ad Performance Analysis: o Regularly review and analyze ad campaign performance using tools and metrics like Google Analytics and Ad Words. o Provide actionable insights and recommendations to enhance campaign effectiveness.
5. Ad Copywriting and A/B Testing: o Craft compelling ad copy that drives click-through rates (CTR) and conversion rates. o Implement A/B testing methodologies to optimize ad creative and landing pages.
6. Competitor Analysis: o Stay updated on industry trends and competitor advertising strategies. o Identify opportunities to gain a competitive edge and propose new campaign ideas.
7. Reporting and Documentation: o Prepare and present detailed performance reports to stakeholders, highlighting key metrics and trends. o Maintain documentation of campaign strategies, experiments, and results.
8. Collaboration: o Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including content creators, designers, and developers, to align advertising efforts with overall marketing strategies.
